data.description:
## Task

Write a RED (failing) behavioral fixture test for `plugins/dso/scripts/migrate-closure-checks.sh`.

The test MUST FAIL because `migrate-closure-checks.sh` does not yet exist. It becomes GREEN only after T2 implements the script.

## Testing Mode: RED

## File Impact
- `tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh` (create)

## Test Fixtures

Create 3 fixture tickets in a temp tracker:

1. **epic-no-section**: Epic with `## Success Criteria` but NO `## Closure Checks` section — expects migration to append the section
2. **epic-has-section**: Epic already has `## Closure Checks` section — expects idempotent skip (SKIPPED:<id>:already-has-section)
3. **story-no-section**: Story (not epic) with `## Success Criteria` but no `## Closure Checks` — expects migration to append the section

## Assertions (all must FAIL before script exists, PASS after)

1. Script exits 0 on normal run
2. Fixture epic-no-section: EDIT event written with description containing `## Closure Checks`
3. Fixture story-no-section: EDIT event written with description containing `## Closure Checks`
4. Output includes MIGRATED:epic-no-section and MIGRATED:story-no-section
5. Output includes SKIPPED:epic-has-section:already-has-section
6. Idempotency: second run exits 0 and emits SKIPPED for all 3 tickets (sentinel check via stamp file)
7. --resume: create a progress file in /tmp referencing epic-no-section as already processed; re-run with --resume skips epic-no-section, migrates story-no-section only
8. Batch progress: output includes BATCH_COMPLETE: line
9. Suite-runner guard: when \_RUN_ALL_ACTIVE=1 and script absent, exits 0 with SKIP message

## Pattern Reference
- Mirror `tests/scripts/test-ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh` structure exactly
- Use `clone_ticket_repo` from `tests/lib/git-fixtures.sh`
- Use `assert_eq`, `assert_contains`, `print_summary` from `tests/lib/assert.sh`
- Use `mktemp` for all temp paths — never hardcoded names

## Acceptance Criteria
- Running `bash tests/scripts/test-migrate-closure-checks.sh` produces FAIL output (RED) before migrate-closure-checks.sh exists
- After T2 implementation, same command produces PASSED: N FAILED: 0
data.title: T1 RED: Write failing test for migrate-closure-checks.sh (fixture tickets, exit codes, idempotency, --resume)
